gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G19_new: THE SUBJECT-CLASSIFICATION GATE, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST IN THIS BATCH. A `Subject of Dispute` value is ICSID'S OWN CLASSIFICATION IN ICSID'S OWN CONTROLLED VOCABULARY, ON ONE PAGE STATE. IT IS NEVER THE CLAIMANT'S PLEADED COVERED INVESTMENT. A claimant asserting a mining concession, an insurance licence or a bank's assets may also plead ancillary intangibles - know-how, technical information, data - as part of the covered investment, and a database with one subject slot per case cannot show that. A NEGATIVE READING OF THIS FIELD MOVES A PROCEEDING TO `assessed negative on ICSID's own subject characterisation, pleaded investment unexamined` AND NEVER TO EXCLUDED. Any restatement in the form `ARB/xx/yy involves no IP` is a breach of this gate.
